scope: GET_REG, SET_INT_REG and SET_REAL_REG on an explicit in-memory NumericRegisters context

reference_basis.documented: Procedure signatures, BOOLEAN real flag and selected INTEGER/REAL GET output, INTEGER/REAL setters and status zero on success
reference_basis.uncertainty: Native counts, initialization, unused-output state, error/status mapping, persistence, concurrent controller updates and real communication are not authenticated

implementation_choices.context: Explicit NumericRegisters(count, initial=None), count 1..32767 and copied integer-keyed int/float values; absent entries stay absent; no implicit zeros or discovery
implementation_choices.types: Distinct int/float kinds, INTEGER checked storage and finite Pythonic REAL; SET_REAL_REG promotes numeric input to float; setter replaces prior kind
implementation_choices.read: GET_REG writes flag, selected exact numeric output and status zero; preserve unused numeric output including unknown state
implementation_choices.status: Portable REGISTER_UNINITIALIZED=1 for absent reads and REGISTER_OUT_OF_RANGE=2 outside explicit count; status-only failure writes; no native code mapping
implementation_choices.guards: Exact ordinary writable output types and pairwise disjoint references checked before bank access; initialization/type/context/overlap failures raise without operation writes
implementation_choices.effects: Arguments once left-to-right, captured input values before later output-index effects; prior effects remain; direct/transitive FOR guards, CONFIG/POSITION protection and routine cleanup
implementation_choices.ownership: Explicit bank shared across runs/programs, detached snapshots, read-only count; earlier completed writes survive later errors/ABORT; no automatic persistence/reset/rollback
implementation_choices.cli: Generated script --registers requires UTF-8 JSON with count/values and optional comments, using canonical decimal string keys; seed detached memory without rewriting input files
implementation_choices.reports: Source-located register_operations, register_policy, transitive potential_register_reads/writes and defensive value-free Program.register_requests reset at run start
implementation_choices.names: Pythonic fallbacks preserve internal routines and ordinary declarations; other controller names remain blocked and strict retains older unsupported calls

retained_boundaries: No controller backend, robot communication, arbitrary external adapters, native register initialization/count/status/persistence or controller acceptance claim
No remote/group numeric registers, R[] syntax or native concurrent-update model; position/string banks and comments have separate offline service contracts
Existing initialization, scalar ranges, references, FOR, step/frame/resource limits and sticky ABORT remain; strict is future work
